title: Save-new check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-a4mk2 0.6's CORE_SAVE_NEW on the Analog Four MKII, which no panel action reaches on OS 1.56. A SAVE NEW CHECK page behind the AMP key: encoder J asks stock's project load for the empty slot 128 with create-if-empty set (the stock request every LOAD passes 0 to), from the page's knob handler inside stock's view dispatch as LOAD FROM does, so the load job makes a new project and saves it there. save-check's bars show the save calls, the kind and the slot; the counts and the request's breadcrumbs are in RAM after the magic SNC1.
